artifacts.synopsis: REs Martinez and Cook complained that Pacific Presbytery erred by tasking its Shepherding Committee to follow up with Valley Presbyterian Church's Session after a dispute about doxologies in worship, alleging this exceeded Presbytery's jurisdictional authority. The SJC denied the complaint on Issue 1 (finding no BCO violation in the visitation itself) but sustained it on Issue 2, concluding Presbytery made clear errors of judgment by sending the Shepherding Committee without sufficiently clear instructions or adequate notice.
